note: verbatim_in_site=false means the reason name comes from the fixbuild brief, not from site code; nearest site-verbatim reason is listed

field-loss.line_rule: one code per line in al:1; one code=value field per ;-segment in ac:1; no code may be dropped in conversion
field-loss.invalid_example: al:1 agent=mia | task=t1 | status=doing -> json {"agent":"mia","task":"t1"} (status dropped)
field-loss.exact_fix: re-run conversion and keep every code; if a code has no target field, keep it as an extra field, never drop it

secret-pattern.line_rule: no line may match a secret pattern; on match, block and never echo the value
secret-pattern.invalid_example: out: key=REDACTED-PATTERN-EXAMPLE (any real key, token, password assignment, email, or private-key block)
secret-pattern.exact_fix: replace the value with redacted, remove the secret from the pack, and re-validate

proof-ref-missing.line_rule: a verdict with basis=files|excerpt must name proof-ref=<artifact-or-pack-id> on the same verdict line
proof-ref-missing.valid_example: verdict: model=mia | claim=fix | proof=code | basis=files | proof-ref=pack-example-000
proof-ref-missing.invalid_example: verdict: model=mia | claim=fix | proof=code | basis=files (no proof-ref)
proof-ref-missing.exact_fix: add proof-ref=<artifact-or-pack-id> naming the file, artifact, or pack that was read

already-claimed.line_rule: one owner per queue task; a claimed task keeps status=doing and its owner until released or its lease expires
already-claimed.valid_example: task=t1 | agent=unassigned | status=todo -> claim -> agent=agent-claimed | status=doing
already-claimed.invalid_example: task=t1 already agent=agent-claimed | status=doing -> second claim by another agent
already-claimed.exact_fix: wait for release or lease expiry (10min), then claim; site-verbatim reason for this state is claim-taken

not-own-published-id.line_rule: delete is allowed only for an id in the publisher's own-published list (browser local list, or aiws published file)
not-own-published-id.valid_example: delete id=pack-example-000 where pack-example-000 is in own-published list
not-own-published-id.exact_fix: delete only ids you published from this browser/tool; otherwise use blocked, do not delete

pack-too-large.valid_example: pack of 102400 bytes or fewer starting with al:1
pack-too-large.exact_fix: slice the pack with the pack slicer to a smaller budget, or split it into two packs

not-marked-public.line_rule: publish requires the explicit public mark: public checkbox in UI, or public=true in the pack for aiws
not-marked-public.valid_example: pack starts al:1, size <= 102400, contains public=true -> publish allowed
not-marked-public.exact_fix: add public=true to the pack (only for content that is genuinely public) and publish again
